articles.title: Appeals Court Rules Pentagon's Transgender Military Ban Unconstitutional
articles.summary: A federal appeals court ruled 2-1 that the Pentagon's policy banning transgender troops is illegal, calling it driven by a "bare desire to harm." The ban remains in effect pending appeal, but current service members are protected.

articles.title: EU Agrees on Controversial Migration Overhaul, Green-Lighting Deportation Hubs Abroad
articles.summary: The EU struck a deal to ramp up deportations and build detention centers outside its borders. Rights groups slam the plan as a "draconian" copy of Trump-era policies, warning it will endanger migrants and undermine human rights.

articles.title: Disappearing Messages and Stolen Phones: Unanswered Questions in the Mandelson Affair
articles.summary: Despite 1,500 pages of released documents, key details about Lord Mandelson's appointment as UK ambassador remain hidden. Missing messages, stolen phones, and redacted files fuel speculation about his ties to Jeffrey Epstein.
